arguments.source:
repos = github.search_repositories(query="agent framework", limit=30)
details = map(repos, github.get_repository(full_name=_.full_name))
ratioed = compute(details, ratio="forks / stars")
high = select(ratioed, "ratio > 0.15")
low = select(ratioed, "ratio <= 0.15")
highScores = map(high, github.get_contributor_stats(full_name=_.full_name))
lowScores = map(low, github.list_commits(full_name=_.full_name))
allScores = concat(highScores, lowScores)
filtered = select(allScores, "score >= 100")
ranked = sort(filtered, key="score", desc=true)
top = take(ranked, 3)
return top
